video_prompt: One continuous full-frame close-up shot in a dark podcast studio lit by a cool blue neon glow; the video fills the whole frame edge to edge from the first frame to the last. The woman — a woman about 40 years old of East Asian descent, straight black shoulder-length hair with blunt bangs, small silver stud earrings, wearing a black fitted turtleneck — wearing black over-ear headphones, speaks into the black podcast microphone, alone in the shot, and stays exactly the same person the whole time: same face, same hair, same clothes, same distance from the camera. Locked-off camera on a tripod; the background stays still. The woman talks toward the right, where the other host sits off-camera, confident and knowing, explaining something, with small natural head movements.
